Over 9.6 hectares, not forest land, but un-forested? The list includes "失火" (fire accident) and "放火" (arson). Need to differentiate: "失火" is accidental fire (unintentional). He used his land, but no. The crime is arson (放火). No other crimes. So final answer: [罪名]放火<eoa>
